intro: A pivotal trial for developing paladins, this task demands the defense of Daphne Stilwell's homestead against a coordinated Defias raid. Outnumbered in the open fields of Westfall, the paladin must hold the line to embody the core tenet of valor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now, they'll be coming again soon, I'd wager, so get yourself ready.
I've got myself a gun in the house. I'll grab it and be ready to help you out, but for the most part, you're on your own.
I've no idea how many they'll send, but I'm sure it'll be more than the few they sent earlier.
Ask the Light for whatever blessings you can because... Did you hear that? I think they're coming.
We make our stand near the house!

clips.title: Progress
paras: We'll make our stand at the house!

clips.title: Completion
paras: We've done it, friend! Thank you for your help. You were truly amazing out there. I never thought a paladin could handle so many enemies at once.
You've truly shown bravery in the face of overwhelming odds.
